plainTranslation: The Pluto person can make Venus feel wanted and trapped at the same time. Attraction may come with jealousy, obsession, or fear of losing the bond. Keep love separate from possession.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
